name: readout
description: A single line of terminal text such as "Load: 42%", with an optional prompt and blinking cursor.

config.name: label
config.label: Label
config.description: The text in front of the value. Defaults to the metric name

config.name: separator
config.label: Separator
config.description: The text between label and value. Defaults to ": "

config.name: prefix
config.label: Prompt
config.description: Text at the start of the line, e.g. "$ " or "> "

config.name: show_cursor
config.label: Blinking Cursor
config.description: Shows a blinking block cursor after the value

config.name: align
config.label: Alignment
config.description: Spread puts the label on the left and the value on the right

config.name: leader
config.label: Leader
config.description: The character that fills the space between label and value when the alignment is Spread, e.g. "."

config.name: hide_unit
config.label: Hide Unit
config.description: Shows the value without its unit

config.name: precision
config.label: Precision
config.description: The number of decimal places. If not set, it is chosen based on the value

config.name: font
config.label: Font
config.description: Use a monospace font for the best result. Defaults to Cascadia Mono, Consolas or the system monospace font

config.name: font_size
config.label: Font Size
config.description: The font size in pixels. The text shrinks when it does not fit the widget

config.name: theme
config.label: Theme
config.description: Color uses the htop and btop palette. Monochrome draws everything in one text color with reverse video headers, like plain top. Colors you set yourself are kept

config.name: text_color
config.label: Label
config.description: The color of the label, separator and leader

config.name: background_color
config.label: Background
config.description: The background color of the widget
